t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two groups of colors, one group of colors will have more mushrooms than the other, when that groups mushrooms start to run low switch to the other group.

vb_textbox.text: There are two groups of colors: Blue, Yellow, Green and Purple, Pink, Brown. When choosing your gnome make sure you choose gnomes that go in the same group. Once you realize the number of mushrooms is dropping switch to the other group of colors. EXAMPLE (you choose a pink gnome for 35 mushrooms, then a brown gnome for 7, and a purple gnome for zero, you should then switch to the other group of colors.) You will not always have those color options, you may have to pick purple twice in a row before you get a brown. You will also have red and orange as a color option, in which you choose one randomly.
